summary: Proposed data centre-led technology and energy campus on around 55 hectares of Nuclear Decommissioning Authority-owned unlicensed land north of the former Chapelcross nuclear power station near Annan. Strategic developer CX Power (a vehicle of GA Consultants and Global Mutual Properties Limited, appointed under Heads of Terms with the NDA in November 2025) proposes up to 161,920 sqm of AI-enabled data centres described as a potential 1 GW campus, plus substation, light industrial space and a skills hub. At pre-application stage: the developer states an EIA scoping report was submitted in March 2026, statutory-style community consultation events ran May-June 2026, and a Planning Permission in Principle application is targeted for December 2026, with phased construction 2027-2035 and first operations claimed possible by 2030.
maturity_explanation: Early development: developer states an EIA scoping report was submitted to Dumfries and Galloway Council in March 2026 and pre-application community consultation events were held in May and June 2026, ahead of a targeted Planning Permission in Principle application in December 2026. No planning application has been identified as validated. Scoping/PAN references could not be verified on the council portal (access blocked), so official-record confirmation is outstanding.
anticipated_construction_start: 2027 (developer-stated phased delivery 2027-2035; SSG material reportedly refers to potential site commencement in 2027)
anticipated_operational_date: 2030 (press-reported 'could be operational by 2030' if consents proceed)

phases.description: Developer states phased delivery of the campus from 2027 to 2035; phase composition not published.

latest_development.headline: Second round of pre-application consultation events held at Creca Village Hall (16 June) and Victoria Halls, Annan (17 June 2026)

unknowns: Official PAN and EIA scoping references on the Dumfries and Galloway portal (portal search blocked by anti-bot protection on 2026-07-30; developer claims scoping submitted March 2026)
Whether the 1 GW figure refers to IT load, grid import or total campus energy capacity — no source defines it
Any grid connection application/offer for the site (no public NESO/SPEN record located)

CX Power Limited ownership: PSC register entries not yet visible at Companies House; relationship between CX Power Limited (16880627), GA Consultants and Global Mutual Properties Limited not documented in filings reviewed
Terms of the NDA-CX Power Heads of Terms (lease vs sale of the 135-acre landholding; consideration)
Any project-specific public subsidy (Borderlands Growth Deal supports the wider Chapelcross programme; no project-specific amount for the data centre campus identified)
Quantified jobs and investment figures (only 'several hundred high value jobs' and 'multi-million pound' stated)
Community representations/objections (none located; consultation feedback not yet published)
